description: This file defines an abstract class LoggerPatternConverter and several subclasses that implement different pattern conversion strategies for logging events in the log4php logging framework. It includes methods for formatting log event data, space padding, and specific converters for timestamps, thread names, levels, MDC, location info, and class/category names.

classes.name: LoggerPatternConverter
classes.description: Abstract base class for pattern converters that format logger event data according to specific patterns.

classes.name: LoggerBasicPatternConverter
classes.description: Concrete subclass providing basic pattern conversions such as relative time, thread name, level, etc.

classes.name: LoggerLiteralPatternConverter
classes.description: Converter that outputs a fixed literal string.

classes.name: LoggerDatePatternConverter
classes.description: Formats dates based on a specified date format pattern.

classes.name: LoggerMDCPatternConverter
classes.description: Extracts and formats Mapped Diagnostic Context data based on a key.

classes.name: LoggerLocationPatternConverter
classes.description: Converts and formats location information of the log event (full info, method, line, file).

classes.name: LoggerNamedPatternConverter
classes.description: Abstract class for pattern converters that deal with name-based patterns such as class and category names.

classes.name: LoggerClassNamePatternConverter
classes.description: Converts logger class names with configurable precision.

classes.name: LoggerCategoryPatternConverter
classes.description: Converts logger category names with configurable precision.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log event into a string buffer based on the converter's logic, handling padding and alignment.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Abstract method to convert a logging event into a string representation specific to the converter.

methods.name: spacePad
methods.description: Adds space padding to a string buffer for alignment.

methods.name: LoggerPatternConverter
methods.description: Constructor for the base class, initializing formatting parameters.

methods.name: LoggerBasicPatternConverter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pattern type and base class.

methods.name: LoggerLocationPatternConverter
methods.description: Constructor setting converter type for location info.

methods.name: LoggerNamedPatternConverter
methods.description: Base class constructor for name pattern converters with specified precision.

methods.name: LoggerClassNamePatternConverter
methods.description: Constructor for class name pattern converter.

methods.name: LoggerCategoryPatternConverter
methods.description: Constructor for category name pattern converter.
